dedupe_keys.name: seasonal crop yield hindcasts for ghana kenya and zimbabwe from lpjml forced with seas5

description: The resource contains LPJmL5 crop-yield hindcasts forced by bias-corrected and downscaled ECMWF SEAS5 forecasts. The provider states coverage of 1994 to 2023, twelve initialisation months and fifteen ensemble members. Gridded NetCDF outputs have 0.1-degree spatial resolution. They support the Foodshed Information Service food-security planning work. Coverage: 1994-2023 Geographic extent follows the named site or scope; unstated extents and sampling intervals remain unknown. Access: public 4TU.ResearchData metadata links describe the release. Formats: NetCDF arrays. Licence: CC-BY-SA-4.0. Cost and present file access are unverified. Caveats: These are original simulation outputs with no post-processing; forecast accuracy was not reproduced. Simulation uses follow the source-defined purpose above. Related resources are retained in the same native collection with their distinct identities.
